description: Manual Assets View metadata-form blueprint, not an Adobe import/export payload. Copy existing editorial tabs before assigning this form. Commerce arrays must stay multi-valued.
name: WKND Commerce Product Assets

fields.label: Use in commerce
fields.description: Managed by the WKND Commerce extension; No permanently excludes the asset from matching.

fields.label: Product SKUs
fields.description: Parent and/or variant SKUs, validated against the custom commerce catalog.

fields.label: Image roles
fields.description: image, small_image, thumbnail, swatch_image, hero or an existing custom_* role. Empty means matcher defaults.

fields.label: Gallery positions
fields.description: Whole-number strings, aligned by index with Product SKUs. The extension supports positions 1 through 9999.

fields.label: Commerce approval status
fields.description: Existing approval metadata read by the matcher; the extension never approves assets.
